question: How was [TEPAH][ATA] synthesized: amounts of TEPA and ATA, solvent, stirring time and evaporation temperature?
expect: 0.0125 mol TEPA and 0.0125 mol ATA in 30 mL ethanol/water (4:1 v/v), stirred 12 h at room temperature, rotary evaporated at 60 C under vacuum (sec. 2.2)
rendered: According to the document, [TEPAH][ATA] was synthesized via a one-step method. The synthesis involved dissolving 0.0125 mol of TEPA and 0.0125 mol of ATA in a 30 mL ethanol/water (4:1 v/v) solution. The mixture was then magnetically stirred at room temperature for 12 h. After stirring, the mixture was rotary evaporated at 60 °C under vacuum to remove excess solvent.
